title: Closing the Loop on Runtime Monitors with Fallback-Safe MPC
venue: IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
tldr: Couples perception runtime monitors with a fallback-safe MPC so a robot can take safety-preserving actions when learned perception becomes unreliable.
relevance_reason: relevant: runtime monitoring with safety fallback

title: Beyond Viewpoint Generalization: What Multi-View Demonstrations Offer and How to Synthesize Them for Robot Manipulation?
tldr: Survey of diffusion policies organized around 3D geometric generalization, real-time physical/tactile interaction and generalist policies.
relevance_reason: relevant: survey covering real-time diffusion policy methods

title: Masked Generative Policy for Robotic Control
reported_metric: up to 35x lower per-sequence inference time
tldr: Masked Generative Policy generates discrete action tokens in parallel and refines only low-confidence ones, giving much faster inference than diffusion or autoregressive policies.
relevance_reason: direct: parallel action decoding

title: Rethinking Language's Role in Efficient VLA for Autonomous Vehicles: Toward Smarter, Trustworthy Driving
tldr: Survey/position on efficient driving VLAs organized by how much language is used at inference (train-only to per-frame generation), tagging methods on latency, parameters, memory, FLOPs and tokens.
relevance_reason: direct: efficiency of VLAs under onboard budgets (driving)

title: DreamPlan: Efficient Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language Planners via Video World Models
tldr: DreamPlan trains an action-conditioned video world model from zero-shot VLM exploration data and then RL-fine-tunes the VLM planner entirely inside that model, avoiding costly physical rollouts.
relevance_reason: relevant: sample-efficient adaptation via world-model imagination

title: Extreme Compression of Large Language Models via Additive Quantization
tldr: AQLM applies multi-codebook additive quantization to LLM weights, reaching strong accuracy at 2-3 bits per parameter.
relevance_reason: foundational technique for extreme weight quantization

title: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
tldr: SkyJEPA learns a JEPA-style latent dynamics model with a physics-inspired prober and pairs it with sampling-based optimal control for real-time quadrotor control on embedded hardware, trained with simulated data for zero-shot sim-to-real.
relevance_reason: direct: latent world model running real-time on embedded hardware

title: MotionStream: Real-Time Video Generation with Interactive Motion Controls
reported_metric: up to 29 FPS streaming, sub-second latency on a single GPU
tldr: MotionStream distills a motion-controlled text-to-video model into a causal streaming generator for real-time interactive video generation.
relevance_reason: foundational technique for real-time video (world-model) generation

title: KV Cache is 1 Bit Per Channel: Efficient Large Language Model Inference with Coupled Quantization
tldr: Coupled Quantization compresses the LLM KV cache to about 1 bit per channel by jointly quantizing correlated channels.
relevance_reason: foundational technique for KV-cache compression

title: Transition Matching Distillation for Fast Video Generation
tldr: Transition Matching Distillation compresses multi-step video diffusion/flow models into few-step generators by matching denoising transitions.
relevance_reason: foundational technique for fast video world models

title: Safety-Critical Manipulation for Collision-Free Food Preparation
tldr: Uses control barrier functions to efficiently modify pre-validated manipulator trajectories for collision-free operation in dynamic cooking environments with safety guarantees.
relevance_reason: relevant: computationally efficient CBF safety filtering

title: HeteroMosaic: Exposing and Exploiting Heterogeneous Execution Opportunities for Energy-Efficient Edge LLM Inference
tldr: HeteroMosaic schedules LLM inference across CPU, integrated GPU and NPU on unified-memory edge SoCs to improve energy efficiency.
relevance_reason: foundational technique for edge SoC inference

title: Simulation Distillation: Pretraining World Models in Simulation for Rapid Real-World Adaptation
tldr: SimDist pretrains a world model in simulation and adapts only the latent dynamics with real-world prediction losses, enabling rapid real-world improvement via planning.
relevance_reason: relevant: efficient real-world adaptation of world models

title: FAVLA: A Force-Adaptive Fast-Slow VLA model for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
tldr: FAVLA decouples a slow VLM planner from a fast force-conditioned action expert whose execution frequency is adaptively scheduled from predicted force variation for reactive contact-rich control.
relevance_reason: direct: fast-slow VLA with adaptive control frequency

title: MAIN-VLA: Modeling Abstraction of Intention and eNvironment for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: MAIN-VLA abstracts instructions and visual streams into compact semantic primitives, and the resulting attention concentration enables parameter-free token pruning in fast-paced game environments.
relevance_reason: relevant: token pruning for real-time VLA decision-making

title: EWMBench: Evaluating Scene, Motion, and Semantic Quality in Embodied World Models
tldr: EWMBench evaluates embodied video world models on scene consistency, motion correctness and semantic alignment rather than generic video quality.
relevance_reason: relevant: benchmarking methodology for world models

title: Failure Prediction with Statistical Guarantees for Vision-Based Robot Control
tldr: Synthesizes failure predictors for vision-based robot control policies with guaranteed bounds on false-positive and false-negative rates.
relevance_reason: relevant: runtime failure prediction with guarantees

title: SpanVLA: Efficient Action Bridging and Learning from Negative-Recovery Samples for Vision-Language-Action Model
tldr: SpanVLA pairs autoregressive reasoning with a flow-matching action expert initialized from historical trajectories to cut action-generation latency in driving VLAs, plus GRPO post-training on negative/recovery samples.
relevance_reason: direct: reduces driving-VLA inference latency

title: Do World Models Make Better Robots? A Survey of Evaluation Benchmarks for Predictive Embodied Intelligence
tldr: Surveys evaluation benchmarks for predictive embodied models and asks whether world modeling yields measurable closed-loop gains over direct VLA policies.
relevance_reason: relevant: benchmarking methodology for world models vs VLAs

title: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
tldr: AdaJEPA adapts a latent world model online inside the MPC loop using observed transitions, improving planning under distribution shift with as little as one gradient step per replan.
relevance_reason: relevant: lightweight test-time adaptation of world models

title: REPO: Reactive Policies with Observation Augmentation
venue: 2026 34th Mediterranean Conference on Control and Automation (MED)
tldr: RePO predicts single-step actions from observation history with adversarial embedding noise, giving reactive yet temporally consistent policies under dynamic perturbations instead of open-loop chunks.
relevance_reason: relevant: reactivity vs open-loop chunk execution

title: L-SDPPO: Policy Optimization of Spiking Diffusion Policy for Intra-vehicular Robotic Manipulation
tldr: L-SDPPO uses an RL-optimized spiking diffusion policy for low-energy manipulation on power-constrained spacecraft robots, with a latency-injection mechanism for dynamic perception.
relevance_reason: direct: energy-efficient diffusion policy

title: ManipulationNet: An Infrastructure for Benchmarking Real-World Robot Manipulation with Physical Skill Challenges and Embodied Multimodal Reasoning
tldr: ManipulationNet is a global infrastructure of standardized hardware kits and a unified client for reproducible, distributed real-world manipulation benchmarking.
relevance_reason: relevant: real-robot benchmarking protocol

title: TopV: Compatible Token Pruning with Inference Time Optimization for Fast and Low-Memory Multimodal Vision Language Model
tldr: TopV prunes visual tokens in VLMs via an inference-time optimization compatible with FlashAttention and KV caching for faster, lower-memory inference.
relevance_reason: foundational technique for VLA token pruning

title: Efficient Real-World Online Reinforcement Learning for Robot Manipulation via Centralized Training and Critic Decomposition
tldr: Improves sample efficiency of real-world online RL for manipulation with centralized training of multiple actors sharing a decomposed task/grasp critic.
relevance_reason: relevant: sample-efficient real-world RL

title: Generative AI at the Edge: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Hardware and Applications
tldr: Survey of architectures, hardware and applications for deploying generative AI models on resource-constrained edge devices.
relevance_reason: foundational: edge-deployment survey connected to several core items
